<issue>
Picture inline creation returns None instead of inline element

#### Description

When creating a new picture inline element, the method returns `None` instead of the expected inline element object. This breaks any code that expects to work with the returned inline element.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.parts.story import StoryPart

# Create a document and try to add an inline picture
doc = Document()
story_part = doc.part

# This should return an inline element but returns None
inline = story_part.new_pic_inline('image.png', width=100, height=200)
print(f"Returned value: {inline}")  # Expected: <CT_Inline object>, Actual: None

# Any subsequent operations on the inline element will fail
if inline is not None:
    print(f"Inline XML: {inline.xml}")
else:
    print("Cannot access inline properties - got None instead")
```

Also noticed that picture dimensions seem to be swapped when setting inline shape dimensions:

```python
from docx import Document

doc = Document()
# Add a picture and set dimensions
inline_shape = doc.add_picture('image.png', width=100, height=200)

# The width and height appear to be swapped
print(f"Expected width: 100, Actual width: {inline_shape.width}")
print(f"Expected height: 200, Actual height: {inline_shape.height}")
```
</issue>
